findings.highlight: the sign that’s constructing the boundary field
findings.evidenceJa: 結界を括っているサイン
findings.governingReading: The mark binds or holds the bounded field together.
findings.explanation: The English changes an anchor’s structural binding function into construction of the entire field.

findings.evidenceJa: あまり水を注さないでよね
findings.governingReading: Shinji tells Shirou not to throw cold water on his excitement.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes interpersonal alienation for spoiling Shinji’s mood.

findings.governingReading: Shinji realizes that a person would normally be wary in this situation.
findings.explanation: The English changes a mental stance of suspicion into the outcome of remaining safe.

findings.highlight: It’ll be no good if Tohsaka finds us.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に見つかったら僕も君も只じゃ済まない
findings.governingReading: Shinji warns that neither of them will get off lightly if Rin catches them.
findings.explanation: The English reduces a pointed threat of consequences for both boys to a vague “no good.”

findings.evidenceJa: 光というものを感じさせない
findings.governingReading: Rider’s inorganic black figure gives no sense of light at all.
findings.explanation: The English mistakes physical or symbolic light for lack of heaviness.

findings.highlight: I want to cooperate with someone I know
findings.evidenceJa: 信用できるヤツと手を組みたい
findings.governingReading: Shinji claims he wants to ally with someone he can trust.
findings.explanation: The English replaces asserted trustworthiness with mere familiarity, softening his attempt to exploit their relationship.

findings.highlight: the literature passed down his family
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐の家に伝わる文献
findings.governingReading: Documents handed down in the Matou family let Shinji understand his situation.
findings.explanation: The English omits the preposition required to express transmission within the family.
